assets.subject: a cat tree (cat climbing furniture)
assets.prompt:
Using the supplied image only as a visual style guide for the Turnip Works house style (heroic hand-painted), create a new, distinct single asset: a cat tree (cat climbing furniture).

Geometry: stout, miniature-compatible proportions; thick functional parts and rails; broad soft bevels; where the object genuinely has handles, hinges or fittings, make them chunky, but NEVER add handles, rings, loops, straps or fittings the real object would not have; deep readable carving rather than fine detail; slightly exaggerated, sturdy construction that could survive as a printed tabletop piece. Every part thick enough to reconstruct as 3D geometry.
Finish: diffuse-first hand-painted game art with broad soft gradients, subtle brush texture, sparing painted edge highlights and gentle wear, low-frequency surface detail, mostly matte.
Palette: rich but softened burgundy, moss green, dusty teal, ochre, cream, warm honey wood and blue-gray stone, used where they suit the object; avoid an all-brown result.
Avoid: invented handles or ring pulls on food, bottles, beds, textiles and other objects that don't have them; multiple views, variants or a grid of the object in one image; photorealism, plastic toy gloss, strong reflections, fine scratches, tiny wood pores, black outlines, hard cel-shading bands, comic inking, flat vector art, thin fragile parts, text, logos, emblems.

Presentation for image-to-3D: exactly one complete asset, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above, clear space around every edge, perfectly uniform solid chroma-blue background, no horizon, no floor plane, no cast shadow, neutral even lighting with no colored light casts, no environment, no people, no additional loose objects. Keep supports and important sides unoccluded. The blue background is a removable mask and must not reflect blue light onto the asset.

Specific design: A piece of pet furniture for cats to climb, about 5 ft tall, on one square wooden base board that sits flat on the floor. From the base rise two FAT upright posts tightly wrapped in thick coils of honey-coloured sisal rope (scratching posts). They carry three broad, thick, rounded platforms at different heights, covered in plush moss-green carpet, the top one a shallow padded perch with a raised rim. At the bottom, on the base, sits a small boxy cubby house covered in burgundy carpet with ONE large round door hole in its front. One short thick cord with a chunky cream pom-pom ball hangs from the edge of a middle platform. Everything is chunky and sturdy: thick platforms, thick posts, no thin parts. NO cat or any animal on it. Real-world size about 34 in wide x 34 in deep x 60 in tall: keep these proportions, clearly taller than wide. It stands on nothing: NO floor patch, NO rug, NO ground disc, NO shadow blob under it. The background is flat chroma blue, so the object itself has NO blue anywhere. Show exactly this one object and nothing else, whole and well inside the frame. Prioritize a clean silhouette readable from an elevated game camera.

gate.desc: a cat tree: cat climbing furniture, a tower of carpeted platforms on rope-wrapped posts with a small cubby house
must: at least two platforms at different heights
at least one post wrapped in rope
a cubby or box with a round door hole
the whole object is in frame
